notes.title: V1.0.7 - Added ability to click with numpad 5 / X
notes.content:
[h3]CHANGELOG[/h3]
ADDED - Pressing numpad 5 or "X" is treated as mouse input (accessibility feature). 

In the future, I have plans to make this and all other input bindable.

tags.feature: ADDED - Pressing numpad 5 or "X" is treated as mouse input (accessibility feature).

notes.title: V1.0.6 - Fixed unpausing camera random movement glitch
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog[/h3]
FIXED - Camera randomly moves when you unpause.
FIXED - Initial level open animation works properly.
FIXED - Spam clicking in one place and then pausing/unpausing no longer causes a crash
CHANGED - Steamdeck miss tap animation no longer is present in desktop version
